title: UploadChunkReceipt
description:
One chunk accepted. Answers idempotently: the same bytes delivered twice for one index yield
two identical-success receipts and leave the recorded state unchanged.

chunk_index.description: The zero-based index the bytes were recorded under. Required.

idempotent_replay.description:
`true` when this delivery replayed an already-recorded index with matching bytes and
changed nothing. Required; lets an at-least-once client distinguish news from echo.

received_chunks_count.description:
How many distinct indices are now recorded, including this one when newly recorded.
Required.

resumption_token.description: The session the chunk joined. Required.

UploadResumptionToken.title: UploadResumptionToken
UploadResumptionToken.description:
Server-issued handle naming one upload session. Required on every chunk receipt, status
and finalize call after opening.

Opaque by contract: a client compares tokens, stores them and presents them back, and
never parses one. The issuing service mints it unguessable — at least 128 bits of entropy
— because whoever holds the token drives the session; expiry is the server's decision,
carried beside the token as `expires_at`, and an expired token is refused with
`blob_transfer.session_expired`, distinct from `blob_transfer.session_unknown`.
